nodes.label: Oral Music and Story Culture
nodes.evidence_status: Instrument histories and terminology are fact-checked; the document explicitly treats early bodhrán prominence cautiously.
nodes.rationale: Fiddlers, uilleann pipers, sean-nós singers, storytellers, and itinerant musicians carried entertainment, memory, and news through performance.

nodes.label: Seasonal Social Gatherings
nodes.rationale: Crossroads dances, pattern days, hurling, wakes, cards, gambling, and winter storytelling create calendar-bound spaces for courtship, rivalry, grief, and information exchange.
